transit.name: Ride Free Longmont
transit.detail: Local bus routes 323, 324, 326 and 327 are free to ride

transit.name: RIDE Longmont
transit.detail: On-demand rides in a partnership of the City of Longmont, Via Transportation and RTD; $2, or $1 for students, seniors and riders with disabilities

transit.name: FLEX
transit.detail: Regional bus operated by Transfort with stops between Fort Collins, Loveland, Berthoud, Longmont and Boulder

nameOrigin.text: The Chicago-Colorado Colony named the town after Longs Peak.

founded.text: Built by members of the Chicago-Colorado Colony

timeline.text: The Colorado Central Railroad began service from Golden to Longmont.
The Longmont Sugar Factory was built on the east edge of town.
Longmont adopted its City Charter and became a home-rule city.
The Great Western Sugar factory in Longmont closed.
A major flood damaged homes, businesses and roads.

sites.name: Longmont Museum
sites.cost: Exhibitions $12 adults, $8 youth; free under 2; free on the second Saturday of each month
